proposed_updates.cost_currency_note: USD. 1-Week Commuter Program $2,882/session; 3-Week Commuter Program $6,380/session; plus an $80 application fee and course-specific materials fees (~$50).

turkey_access_reasoning: This program's own page was silent on nationality, but it is one of several sub-tracks listed under Columbia's single 'Columbia University Programs for High School Students' umbrella, whose shared eligibility statement (found in the seed counselor-list document, cross-checked against Columbia's own admissions framing) explicitly states 'Domestic and international students who will be enrolled in grades 9-12 in the fall...are invited to apply.' Treating this as applicable to NYC Commuter Summer specifically because it is administered by the same office under the same general admissions policy, not because of marketing language on this one subpage alone.

title: Parsons Summer Intensive Studies
organizer: Parsons School of Design, The New School
host_institution: Parsons School of Design, New York, NY

proposed_updates.citizenship_restrictions: None -- international students are explicitly and specifically accommodated with their own earlier registration deadline (April 1) distinct from the general deadline, evidence of a real operational international-applicant process rather than unaddressed silence.
proposed_updates.cost_currency_note: USD. $5,610 tuition + $265 university fees. Optional housing: $2,180 for three weeks (includes $375 starter meal funds and $200 Activity/Coordination Fee).
proposed_updates.current_cycle_label: 2026 cycle: Session 1 general deadline May 8 / international deadline April 1; Session 2 general deadline June 1 (May 8 if applying for housing) / international deadline April 1 -- all already elapsed as of this research (2026-08-26).

turkey_access_reasoning: A distinctly earlier, formally-designated international-student deadline is concrete operational evidence of a real and specific international admissions pathway, not generic marketing language.

evidence.quote: Ages 16-18...international students have an earlier registration deadline of April 1 for both sessions...$5,610 plus $265 university fees...optional housing at $2,180 for three weeks

notes: Distinct from the separately-live 'Summer Intensive Programs at Parsons Paris' program mentioned in seed PDF #3 -- same parent institution (Parsons/The New School) but a different city, different application process, and (per the seed document) open enrollment rather than a competitive deadline structure; treat as a separate canonical entity if Parsons Paris is ever added, not a duplicate of this NY-based program.
